page_title: MNU 0-2 WHU | Manchester Utd v West Ham 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The cross into the penalty area from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
90+5' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny James Ward-Prowse (West Ham), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net.
90+4' Harry Amass (Manchester United) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+3' West Ham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.

90' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
90' Manchester Utd quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Manchester Utd win a corner.
88' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and it's Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alphonse Areola, who smothers the ball.
87' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
86' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
85' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for an infringement. Manchester Utd have a free kick.
83' Today's match ends for Vladimir Coufal who will be replaced by Emerson (West Ham).
83' Here is a change. Jean-Clair Todibo is going off and Graham Potter gives the last tactical orders to Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amad Diallo leaves the pitch and Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) comes on.
82' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United).
79' Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

79' Alphonse Areola makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the left side of the target.
79' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
79' Manchester Utd will take a free kick. Max Kilman (West Ham) is penalised for holding. Jarred Gillett signals a set piece.

77' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) attempts to beat Alphonse Areola with a header from the corner kick. He sends his effort low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a nice save. The score remains the same.
77' The referee awards a corner and Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take it.
76' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
75' The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester Utd are going to take it.
75' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
73' Graham Potter has decided to substitute Mohammed Kudus and he is replaced by Carlos Soler (West Ham).
73' The substitution has been made. Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) has replaced Jarrod Bowen.
72' Harry Amass (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Alphonse Areola comes off his line to gather the ball.
71' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
66' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) gets on the end of the free kick and unleashes a header. The effort is not accurate enough and goes well wide of the left post.
65' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
64' Here comes a substitution. Guido Rodriguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Edson Alvarez (West Ham).
62' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
61' The game is interrupted. Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
59' Ruben Amorim has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) replacing Mason Mount.
59' The referee signals a substitution. Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is brought on as a substitute for Manuel Ugarte.
57' 0 - 2 Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
57' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
56' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

56' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester Utd will take a corner.

55' Manchester Utd fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

54' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Mason Mount (Manchester United), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
54' PENALTY APPEAL after Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
52' Ruben Amorim prepares a substitution. Luke Shaw is replaced by Victor Lindelof (Manchester United).
52' Ruben Amorim is forced to make a change. Leny Yoro (Manchester United) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Harry Maguire.
49' Looks like Leny Yoro (Manchester United) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
46' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Altay Bayindir made a easy save.
46' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
43' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
43' A cross from a corner kick by West Ham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
42' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. West Ham win a corner kick.
40' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
39' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' Mason Mount (Manchester United) tries to find Rasmus Hojlund, but he puts too much power on the pass.
34' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
32' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
26' 0 - 1 Tomas Soucek (West Ham) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
24' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
23' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
17' The linesman signals that Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
14' Neat passing move from Manchester Utd in order to create new attacking opportunities.
10' The ball rebounds out to Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.

10' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the left post, but Alphonse Areola makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
8' The free kick finds Max Kilman (West Ham) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just over the bar from close range.
7' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) trips an opposition player and Jarred Gillett signals a foul. West Ham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
4' What a chance that is! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
West Ham will kick the game off.
Jarred Gillett will supervise the game today.
